tbesh_html:
1) to go, to go away, to go about
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to go away
1a2) to go about
1a3) to be used up, be exhausted, be gone, evaporated
1b) (Pual) to go to and fro

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to go away, hence, to disappear
strongs_1890.kjv_def: fail, gad about, go to and fro (but in Ezekiel 27:19 the word is rendered by many 'from Uzal,' by others 'yarn'), be gone (spent).
